name: Hyori Mika
bio: Hyori Mikaveli Taslim is an Indonesian rising actress and the daughter of well-known action actor Joe Taslim. She makes her feature film acting debut as the character Julia in the drama film Desember Jani (Jani Be Good), directed by Ariani Darmawan and produced by Palari Films.

credits.title: Jani Be Good
credits.overview: Ten days after her sister Julia leaves home without a word, Jani (13) wants only one thing: her return. Jani knows her mother, Winnie, is the reason Julia left, and the two are growing distant while Winnie buries her guilt in work. Only Oma, the grandmother, comforts Jani.
